data.name: Alagesan
data.gender_notes: Alagesan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the universe and all creation. Alaga means ruler and Lord Shanmeaning God Shiva. The name Alagesan carries the meaning “Ruler of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Alagesan usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Alagesan is a powerful name that represents the divine power of the universe. It is believed that those named Alagesan are blessed with the ability to rule over their own lives and possess the wisdom and strength to overcome any obstacle.
data.etymology: Alagesan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alagesan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alagesan holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, particularly in Tamil Nadu in South India. The name Alaga signifies power, authority, and protection, as well as a leader or ruler. This name is often given to individuals who are expected to uphold traditional values andserve as role models within their community. The name Alagesan is also associated with the revered deity Lord Shiva, who is considered the ultimate ruler of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Alagesan embodies the divine power and sovereignty of Lord Shiva. It is believed that those bearing this name have a deep connection to the divine, and are called to use their power and authority for the betterment of the world and the welfare of others. The name Alagesan can serve as a reminder of the ultimate reality of the universe being governed by God, and the role of individuals as co-creators and steward of this reality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Alagesan: God of wisdom and prosperity. One who is protected by the grace of Lord Alagar, the presiding deity of Thiruchendur temple in Tamil Nadu, India.
